note: #1789-#1791: 'Not in the end-to-end journey' is the Ready to send card's reason in a test run only
title: Ready to send shows internal test wording
detail: The 'Ready to send' card shows a 'Not available' badge with 'Not in the end-to-end journey: it never reaches our server.' This is internal jargon, and 'Try again' is offered.
